cn_steps: 启用 `Movie Render Queue`（模块 `MovieRenderPipelineCore`、`MovieRenderPipelineSettings`、`MovieRenderPipelineRenderPasses`、`MovieRenderPipelineMP4Encoder`、`UEOpenExrRTTI`，编辑器 `MovieRenderPipelineEditor`）。
它是高级电影渲染管线，用于高质量渲染过场动画/多媒体（抗锯齿、多通道、MP4/EXR 输出）。
通过 MRQ 面板排队渲染、配置设置与输出，得到最终画面。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；`MovieRenderPipelineEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Movie Render Queue` (modules `MovieRenderPipelineCore`, `MovieRenderPipelineSettings`, `MovieRenderPipelineRenderPasses`, `MovieRenderPipelineMP4Encoder`, `UEOpenExrRTTI`, editor `MovieRenderPipelineEditor`).
It is an advanced movie-render pipeline for high-quality cinematics/multimedia (AA, multi-pass, MP4/EXR output).
Queue renders in the MRQ panel, set settings and outputs, and produce final frames.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; `MovieRenderPipelineEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 高质量电影渲染管线（MRQ），输出 MP4/EXR/多通道。
note_en: The high-quality movie-render pipeline (MRQ) with MP4/EXR/multi-pass output.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Movie Scene Pose Search Tracks`（运行时 `MovieScenePoseSearchTracks`，编辑器 `MovieScenePoseSearchTracksEditor`）。
它用 Anim Mixer 在 Sequencer 里提供姿势搜索（Pose Search）轨道。
在 Sequencer 里加姿势搜索轨道，用轨迹数据驱动动画选择。
Experimental：接口可能变动；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Movie Scene Pose Search Tracks` (runtime `MovieScenePoseSearchTracks`, editor `MovieScenePoseSearchTracksEditor`).
It provides Sequencer pose-search tracks using the Anim Mixer.
Add a pose-search track in Sequencer to drive animation selection from trajectory data.
Experimental: contract may change; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: Sequencer 里基于 Anim Mixer 的姿势搜索轨道，实验性。
note_en: Sequencer pose-search tracks using the Anim Mixer, experimental.

cn_steps: `MovieSceneTextTrack` 是已弃用（Deprecated）插件。
文本支持已移到内置的 Movie Scene Tracks 中。
迁移到内置轨道，不要在 `Build.cs` 新增对该插件依赖。
迁移完成后禁用本插件。
en_steps: `MovieSceneTextTrack` is a deprecated plugin.
Text support has moved into the built-in Movie Scene Tracks.
Migrate to the built-in track; do not add new `Build.cs` dependencies on this plugin.
Disable this plugin after migration.
note_cn: 已弃用，文本支持移到内置 Movie Scene Tracks。
note_en: Deprecated; text support moved into built-in Movie Scene Tracks.

cn_steps: 启用 `MP4 (ISO/IEC 14496-12) utilities`（模块 `MP4Utilities`、`MP4Boxes`、`MP4Muxer`）。
它提供处理 mp4 文件的帮助程序（解析 box、封装/mux 等）。
在媒体处理/编码流程里读写 mp4 封装，供 Media Framework/Electra 播放。
属 Media Framework 工具模块，运行时模块可进包。
en_steps: Enable `MP4 (ISO/IEC 14496-12) utilities` (modules `MP4Utilities`, `MP4Boxes`, `MP4Muxer`).
It provides helpers to work with mp4 files (parse boxes, mux, etc.).
Read/write mp4 containers in media-processing/encoding flows for Media Framework/Electra playback.
It is a Media Framework utility module; runtime modules can ship.
note_cn: 处理 mp4 文件的工具（box 解析/mux）。

cn_steps: 启用 `MQTT`（运行时 `MQTTCore`，编辑器 `MQTTCoreEditor`）。
它提供 MQTT 代理（broker）与客户端，用于 IoT/消息发布订阅。
用 MQTT 客户端连接 broker，订阅/发布主题，对接外部设备数据。
Game 模块依赖 `MQTTCore`；`MQTTCoreEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `MQTT` (runtime `MQTTCore`, editor `MQTTCoreEditor`).
It provides an MQTT broker and client for IoT/pub-sub messaging.
Use the MQTT client to connect to a broker, subscribe/publish topics, and hook external device data.
Game modules depend on `MQTTCore`; `MQTTCoreEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: MQTT 代理与客户端（IoT/发布订阅）。

cn_steps: 启用 `MsQuic Runtime Plugin`（模块 `MsQuicRuntime`），运行时插件。
它把 MsQuic 库（基于 QUIC 的传输）作为运行时依赖提供。
在需要 QUIC 传输的网络/服务集成里，基于它构建连接。
运行时模块可进游戏包；属底层传输库封装。
en_steps: Enable `MsQuic Runtime Plugin` (module `MsQuicRuntime`), a runtime plugin.
It provides the MsQuic library (QUIC-based transport) as a runtime dependency.
Use it to build connections in network/service integrations that need QUIC transport.
Runtime modules can ship; it is a low-level transport library wrapper.
note_en: A runtime wrapper for the MsQuic (QUIC) library.

cn_steps: 启用 `Multi-server Replication`（模块 `MultiServerReplication`、`MultiServerConfiguration`）。
它提供帮助多个 UE 服务器进程相互连接的代码（多服务器分区/网关）。
在分区分服/多进程服务器架构里配置服务器互连与复制。
属联网扩展；具体拓扑以源码/文档为准。
en_steps: Enable `Multi-server Replication` (modules `MultiServerReplication`, `MultiServerConfiguration`).
It provides code to help connect multiple UE server processes to each other (multi-server partitioning/gateway).
In a partitioned/multi-process server architecture, configure server interconnection and replication.
It is a networking extension; topology specifics follow source/docs.
note_cn: 多服务器进程互连与复制的代码。
note_en: Code facilitating multi-server-process interconnection and replication.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Multi-User Editing`（模块 `MultiUserClient`、`MultiUserClientLibrary`、`MultiUserReplicationEditor`）并重启。
它允许在编辑器中进行协作多用户会话（Concert），在多台编辑器间同步关卡与资产更改。
加入/创建多用户会话（session），多人同时编辑同一工程。
这是编辑器/开发者插件，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Multi-User Editing` (modules `MultiUserClient`, `MultiUserClientLibrary`, `MultiUserReplicationEditor`) and restart.
It allows collaborative multi-user sessions (Concert) in the editor, syncing level and asset edits across editor machines.
Join/create a multi-user session so several people edit the same project simultaneously.
It is an editor/developer plugin for Editor targets only; it does not ship.
note_cn: 多用户协作编辑会话（Concert），多台编辑器同步。
note_en: Collaborative multi-user editing sessions (Concert) syncing across editors.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Multi User Server`（模块 `MultiUserServer`）并重启。
它提供可视化的多用户服务器（Concert 服务端），供多个编辑器客户端连接。
启动多用户服务器，客户端加入同一会话进行协作。
这是编辑器/开发者插件，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Multi User Server` (module `MultiUserServer`) and restart.
It provides a visualized multi-user server (Concert server) for multiple editor clients to connect to.
Start the multi-user server and have clients join the same session for collaboration.
It is an editor/developer plugin for Editor targets only; it does not ship.
note_cn: 可视化的多用户（Concert）服务器端。

cn_steps: 启用 `Multicast Analytics Provider`（运行时 `AnalyticsMulticast`，编辑器 `AnalyticsMulticastEditor`）。
它把分析（analytics）API 调用转发到一组分析提供商，一次把数据记录到多个服务。
配置多个下游 provider，事件经它广播给全部目标。
Game 模块依赖 `AnalyticsMulticast`；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Multicast Analytics Provider` (runtime `AnalyticsMulticast`, editor `AnalyticsMulticastEditor`).
It forwards analytics API calls to a list of analytics providers, logging data to multiple services at once.
Configure multiple downstream providers; events broadcast to all of them.
Game modules depend on `AnalyticsMulticast`; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 把分析调用广播到多个 provider（一次上报多服务）。
note_en: Forwards analytics calls to multiple providers at once.

cn_steps: 启用 `Music Environment`（运行时 `MusicEnvironment`，编辑器 `MusicEnvironmentEditor`，测试 `MusicEnvironmentTests`），运行时插件。
它提供项目范围内的音乐信息源：音乐同步时钟、音乐事件等。
在音游/音乐驱动玩法里用其同步时钟与事件对齐节奏。
Runtime 模块可进游戏包；测试模块不进正式产品。
en_steps: Enable `Music Environment` (runtime `MusicEnvironment`, editor `MusicEnvironmentEditor`, tests `MusicEnvironmentTests`), a runtime plugin.
It provides a project-wide source of musical information: musically synchronized clocks, events, etc.
In rhythm/music-driven gameplay, use its sync clocks and events to align to the beat.
Runtime modules can ship; keep the test module out of production.
note_cn: 项目级音乐信息源（同步时钟/事件），音游向。
note_en: A project-wide musical info source (sync clocks/events) for rhythm gameplay.

cn_steps: 启用 `Mutable Agent Skills`（模块 `MutableAgentSkills`）。
它让 AI 代理使用 `CustomizableObjectEditor.CustomizableObjectScriptingSubsystem` 工具集创作 Mutable 可自定义对象。
在 Mutable 角色/物件创作流程里用 AI 代理通过脚本子系统批量生成/编辑。
属 AI 工具链/Mutable 编辑自动化，非运行时功能。
en_steps: Enable `Mutable Agent Skills` (module `MutableAgentSkills`).
It lets AI agents author Mutable Customizable Objects using the `CustomizableObjectEditor.CustomizableObjectScriptingSubsystem` toolset.
In Mutable character/object authoring, use AI agents via the scripting subsystem to batch-generate/edit.
It is AI-toolchain/Mutable authoring automation, not a runtime feature.
note_cn: AI 代理创作 Mutable 可自定义对象的技能/工具集。
note_en: AI-agent skills for authoring Mutable Customizable Objects.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Mutable Asset User Data`（模块 `MutableAssetUserData`）。
它添加 Mutable 相关的资产用户数据类型和操作。
给 Mutable/相关资产挂自定义 user data，按需读取处理。
Experimental：接口可能变动；属 Mutable 数据扩展。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Mutable Asset User Data` (module `MutableAssetUserData`).
It adds an Asset User Data type and operations for Mutable.
Attach custom user data to Mutable/related assets and read/process as needed.
Experimental: contract may change; it is a Mutable data extension.
note_cn: Mutable 的资产用户数据类型与操作，实验性。
note_en: Asset User Data type and operations for Mutable, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Mutable Clothing`（模块 `MutableClothing`）。
它为 Mutable 增加处理服装的能力（可自定义服装）。
在 Mutable 角色自定义里用其节点/逻辑处理衣物。
Experimental：接口可能变动；需 Mutable 相关插件。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Mutable Clothing` (module `MutableClothing`).
It adds Mutable functionality to work with clothing (customizable garments).
In Mutable character customization, use its nodes/logic to handle clothing.
Experimental: contract may change; requires Mutable-related plugins.
note_cn: Mutable 处理服装（可自定义衣物）的能力，实验性。
note_en: Mutable functionality for customizable clothing, experimental.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Mutable Dataflow Extensions`（模块 `MutableDataflowEditor`）。
它为 Mutable 添加在 Dataflow 插件里使用 Dataflow 对象的能力；注意其节点均为实验性，未来可能变更/弃用。
在 Dataflow 图里用 Mutable 节点（目前能力有限、需手动操作）。
Experimental：接口可能变动；属 Mutable + Dataflow 集成。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Mutable Dataflow Extensions` (module `MutableDataflowEditor`).
It adds Mutable functionality to work with Dataflow objects from the Dataflow plugin; note all its nodes are experimental and may change/be deprecated.
Use Mutable nodes in Dataflow graphs (currently limited and manual).
Experimental: contract may change; it is Mutable + Dataflow integration.
note_cn: Mutable 在 Dataflow 中处理对象的扩展（节点实验性、能力有限）。
note_en: Mutable + Dataflow object extensions (experimental nodes, limited).
